<script>
const RAW = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('dashboard-data').textContent);
const GROUP_COLORS = {
  'Limits': '#3D6CB3', 'Combo Limits': '#E08A3C', 'VAS': '#4F9D69', 'C2B': '#8E6FBE', 'Other': '#7D8C9E'
};
const PALETTE = ['#3D6CB3','#E08A3C','#4F9D69','#C4514E','#8E6FBE','#3EA6A6','#B0895F','#7D8C9E','#C767A3'];

function fmtNum(v){
  if (v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v)) return '—';
  const sign = v < 0 ? '-' : '';
  v = Math.abs(v);
  if (v >= 1e7) return sign + (v/1e7).toFixed(2) + 'Cr';
  if (v >= 1e5) return sign + (v/1e5).toFixed(2) + 'L';
  if (v >= 1e3) return sign + (v/1e3).toFixed(1) + 'K';
  return sign + v.toFixed(0);
}
function fmtInt(v){
  if (v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v)) return '—';
  return Math.round(v).toLocaleString('en-IN');
}
function fmtCurrency(v){ return '₹' + fmtNum(v); }
function fmtPct(v){
  if (v === null || v === undefined || !isFinite(v)) return '—';
  const sign = v >= 0 ? '+' : '';
  return sign + (v*100).toFixed(1) + '%';
}
function pctClass(v){
  if (v === null || v === undefined || !isFinite(v)) return '';
  return v >= 0 ? 'pos' : 'neg';
}
function daysBetween(a,b){
  return Math.round((b - a) / 86400000) + 1;
}
function toDate(s){ return new Date(s + 'T00:00:00Z'); }
function isoDate(d){ return d.toISOString().slice(0,10); }
function addDays(d, n){ const nd = new Date(d); nd.setUTCDate(nd.getUTCDate()+n); return nd; }
function ymOf(d){ return `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(d.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`; }
function monthLabel(ym){
  const [y,m] = ym.split('-').map(Number);
  return new Date(Date.UTC(y,m-1,1)).toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short',year:'numeric',timeZone:'UTC'});
}
function monthStart(y,m){ return new Date(Date.UTC(y,m,1)); }
function monthEnd(y,m){ return addDays(new Date(Date.UTC(y,m+1,1)), -1); }
function lastDayOfMonth(y,m){ return monthEnd(y,m).getUTCDate(); }
function fyOf(ym){
  const [y,m] = ym.split('-').map(Number); // m is 1-12
  const fyStart = m >= 4 ? y : y - 1;
  return `FY${String(fyStart).slice(-2)}-${String(fyStart+1).slice(-2)}`;
}

// Checkbox-dropdown multi-select. Empty selection is treated the same as "all selected" (no filtering)
// so unchecking every box doesn't silently blank every chart.
class MultiSelect {
  constructor(containerId, items, allLabel, onChange){
    this.container = document.getElementById(containerId);
    this.items = items; // [{value:'0', label:'Real Estate'}, ...]
    this.selected = new Set(items.map(i=>i.value));
    this.allLabel = allLabel;
    this.onChange = onChange;
    this._render();
  }
  _render(){
    this.container.innerHTML =
      `<button type="button" class="ms-btn"></button>
       <div class="ms-panel" style="display:none;">
         <div class="ms-actions">
           <button type="button" data-act="all">All</button>
           <button type="button" data-act="none">None</button>
         </div>
         <div class="ms-list">${this.items.map(it=>
           `<label class="ms-opt"><input type="checkbox" value="${it.value}" checked><span>${it.label}</span></label>`
         ).join('')}</div>
       </div>`;
    this.btn = this.container.querySelector('.ms-btn');
    this.panel = this.container.querySelector('.ms-panel');
    this.btn.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ e.stopPropagation(); this._toggle(); });
    this.panel.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ e.stopPropagation(); });
    this.panel.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]').forEach(cb=>{
      cb.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
        if (cb.checked) this.selected.add(cb.value); else this.selected.delete(cb.value);
        this._updateLabel(); this.onChange();
      });
    });
    this.panel.querySelector('[data-act="all"]').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      this.panel.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]').forEach(cb=>{ cb.checked=true; this.selected.add(cb.value); });
      this._updateLabel(); this.onChange();
    });
    this.panel.querySelector('[data-act="none"]').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      this.panel.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]').forEach(cb=>{ cb.checked=false; });
      this.selected.clear();
      this._updateLabel(); this.onChange();
    });
    this._updateLabel();
  }
  selectOnly(values){
    const set = new Set(values.map(String));
    this.selected = new Set(this.items.filter(it=>set.has(String(it.value))).map(it=>it.value));
    if (this.panel){
      this.panel.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]').forEach(cb=>{ cb.checked = this.selected.has(cb.value); });
    }
    this._updateLabel();
  }
  _toggle(){
    const show = this.panel.style.display === 'none';
    document.querySelectorAll('.ms-panel').forEach(p=>{ p.style.display = 'none'; });
    this.panel.style.display = show ? 'block' : 'none';
  }
  _updateLabel(){
    const n = this.selected.size, total = this.items.length;
    if (n===0 || n===total) this.btn.textContent = this.allLabel;
    else if (n<=2) this.btn.textContent = this.items.filter(i=>this.selected.has(i.value)).map(i=>i.label).join(', ');
    else this.btn.textContent = `${n} of ${total} selected`;
  }
  isAll(){ return this.selected.size===0 || this.selected.size===this.items.length; }
  has(value){ return this.isAll() || this.selected.has(String(value)); }
}
document.addEventListener('click', ()=> document.querySelectorAll('.ms-panel').forEach(p=>p.style.display='none'));

class Dashboard {
  constructor(raw){
    this.raw = raw;
    this.charts = {};
    this.sortState = { col: 'collB', dir: 'desc' };
    this.calendarMetric = 'collection';
    this.growthView = 'total';
    this.init();
  }

  init(){
    this.buildMonthsList();
    this.setupFilters();
    this.setupPeriods();
    this.setupHeader();
    this.applyFilters();
  }

  buildMonthsList(){
    const minD = toDate(this.raw.meta.min_date), maxD = toDate(this.raw.meta.max_date);
    this.months = [];
    let cursor = monthStart(minD.getUTCFullYear(), minD.getUTCMonth());
    while (cursor <= maxD){
      this.months.push(ymOf(cursor));
      cursor = new Date(Date.UTC(cursor.getUTCFullYear(), cursor.getUTCMonth()+1, 1));
    }
  }

  setupHeader(){
    const meta = this.raw.meta;
    document.getElementById('header-subtitle').textContent =
      `Data range: ${meta.min_date} to ${meta.max_date} · ${meta.row_count.toLocaleString('en-IN')} transactions`;
    document.getElementById('footer-note').textContent =
      `Collection = gross sales value. Packages = distinct orders. DRR = period total ÷ number of days in the selected window. Source: Organic raw dump.xlsx (Dump sheet).`;
  }

  setupFilters(){
    const onChange = () => this.applyFilters();
    this.msCategory = new MultiSelect('ms-category', this.raw.cats.map((c,i)=>({value:String(i), label:c})), 'All Categories', onChange);
    this.msGrouping = new MultiSelect('ms-grouping', this.raw.groupings.map((g,i)=>({value:String(i), label:g})), 'All Groupings', onChange);
    this.msSize = new MultiSelect('ms-size', this.raw.sizes.map((s,i)=>({value:String(i), label:s})), 'All Sizes', onChange);
    this.msFlow = new MultiSelect('ms-flow', this.raw.flows.map((f,i)=>({value:String(i), label:f})), 'All Flows', onChange);

    const fys = [...new Set(this.months.map(fyOf))]; // this.months is chronological, so FYs come out in order
    this.msFY = new MultiSelect('ms-fy', fys.map(fy=>({value:fy, label:fy})), 'All Years', onChange);
    const currentFY = fyOf(ymOf(toDate(this.raw.meta.max_date)));
    this.msFY.selectOnly([currentFY]);
  }

  setupPeriods(){
    ['mj-total-a','mj-total-b'].forEach(id=>{
      const sel = document.getElementById(id);
      sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Jump to full month&hellip;</option>' +
        this.months.map(ym=>`<option value="${ym}">${monthLabel(ym)}</option>`).join('');
    });

    ['p-total-a-start','p-total-a-end','p-total-b-start','p-total-b-end']
      .forEach(id => { document.getElementById(id).min = this.raw.meta.min_date; document.getElementById(id).max = this.raw.meta.max_date; });

    this.applyPreset('mtd_lmtd', true);
  }

  // ---- Period helpers ----
  computeMTD(){
    const maxD = toDate(this.raw.meta.max_date);
    return [monthStart(maxD.getUTCFullYear(), maxD.getUTCMonth()), maxD];
  }
  computeLMTD(){
    const maxD = toDate(this.raw.meta.max_date);
    const dayNum = maxD.getUTCDate();
    let y = maxD.getUTCFullYear(), m = maxD.getUTCMonth() - 1;
    if (m < 0){ m = 11; y -= 1; }
    const start = monthStart(y, m);
    const endDay = Math.min(dayNum, lastDayOfMonth(y, m));
    return [start, addDays(start, endDay - 1)];
  }
  computeLYLMTD(){
    const maxD = toDate(this.raw.meta.max_date);
    const dayNum = maxD.getUTCDate();
    const y = maxD.getUTCFullYear() - 1, m = maxD.getUTCMonth();
    const start = monthStart(y, m);
    const endDay = Math.min(dayNum, lastDayOfMonth(y, m));
    return [start, addDays(start, endDay - 1)];
  }
  computeDefault(){
    const maxD = toDate(this.raw.meta.max_date);
    const curStart = monthStart(maxD.getUTCFullYear(), maxD.getUTCMonth());
    let py = maxD.getUTCFullYear(), pm = maxD.getUTCMonth() - 1;
    if (pm < 0){ pm = 11; py -= 1; }
    const priorStart = monthStart(py, pm), priorEnd = monthEnd(py, pm);
    return { totalA: [priorStart, priorEnd], totalB: [curStart, maxD] };
  }

  setDateField(prefix, range){
    document.getElementById(`p-${prefix}-start`).value = isoDate(range[0]);
    document.getElementById(`p-${prefix}-end`).value = isoDate(range[1]);
  }

  applyPreset(type, silent){
    let ranges;
    if (type === 'mtd_lmtd'){
      const mtd = this.computeMTD(), lmtd = this.computeLMTD();
      ranges = { totalA: lmtd, totalB: mtd };
    } else if (type === 'mtd_lylmtd'){
      const mtd = this.computeMTD(), ly = this.computeLYLMTD();
      ranges = { totalA: ly, totalB: mtd };
    } else {
      ranges = this.computeDefault();
    }
    this.setDateField('total-a', ranges.totalA);
    this.setDateField('total-b', ranges.totalB);

    document.querySelectorAll('.preset-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
    const btn = document.getElementById('preset-' + type.replace(/_/g,'-'));
    if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');

    if (!silent) this.applyFilters();
  }

  onManualDateChange(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.preset-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
    this.applyFilters();
  }

  pickMonth(prefix, ym){
    if (!ym) return;
    const [y, m] = ym.split('-').map(Number);
    const start = monthStart(y, m-1);
    const maxD = toDate(this.raw.meta.max_date);
    let end = monthEnd(y, m-1);
    if (end > maxD) end = maxD;
    this.setDateField(prefix, [start, end]);
    document.getElementById(`mj-${prefix}`).value = '';
    this.onManualDateChange();
  }

  rowPassesFilters(r){
    if (!this.msCategory.has(r[1])) return false;
    if (!this.msGrouping.has(r[2])) return false;
    if (!this.msSize.has(r[4])) return false;
    if (!this.msFlow.has(r[5])) return false;
    return true;
  }

  getPeriods(){
    const g = id => document.getElementById(id).value;
    // DRR View is driven by the same Total View period selection (single date filter).
    const totalA = [g('p-total-a-start'), g('p-total-a-end')];
    const totalB = [g('p-total-b-start'), g('p-total-b-end')];
    return { totalA, totalB, drrA: totalA, drrB: totalB };
  }

  filterDaily(startISO, endISO){
    const rows = this.raw.daily;
    const out = [];
    for (let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
      const r = rows[i];
      const d = r[0];
      if (d < startISO || d > endISO) continue;
      if (!this.rowPassesFilters(r)) continue;
      out.push(r);
    }
    return out;
  }

  sumRows(rows){
    let sales=0, orders=0, users=0;
    for (const r of rows){ sales += r[6]; orders += r[7]; users += r[8]; }
    return { sales, orders, users };
  }

  byPackageType(rows){
    // key: grpIdx-subIdx
    const map = new Map();
    for (const r of rows){
      const key = r[2] + '|' + r[3];
      if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, { grp: r[2], sub: r[3], sales:0, orders:0, users:0 });
      const o = map.get(key);
      o.sales += r[6]; o.orders += r[7]; o.users += r[8];
    }
    return map;
  }

  applyFilters(){
    const periods = this.getPeriods();
    const dA = this.filterDaily(...periods.totalA);
    const dB = this.filterDaily(...periods.totalB);
    const drrA = this.filterDaily(...periods.drrA);
    const drrB = this.filterDaily(...periods.drrB);

    const daysA = daysBetween(toDate(periods.drrA[0]), toDate(periods.drrA[1]));
    const daysB = daysBetween(toDate(periods.drrB[0]), toDate(periods.drrB[1]));
    document.getElementById('drr-a-days').textContent = `(${daysA} day${daysA===1?'':'s'})`;
    document.getElementById('drr-b-days').textContent = `(${daysB} day${daysB===1?'':'s'})`;

    this.state = { dA, dB, drrA, drrB, daysA, daysB, periods };
    this.forecast = this.computeForecast();

    this.safeRender('renderKPIs');
    this.safeRender('renderTable');
    this.safeRender('renderForecastPanel');
    this.safeRender('renderGrowthPanels');
    this.safeRender('renderCalendarGrid');
    this.safeRender('renderCategoryForecastTable');
    if (typeof Chart === 'undefined'){
      if (!this._chartWarned){
        this._chartWarned = true;
        document.querySelectorAll('.chart-container canvas').forEach(c=>{
          const note = document.createElement('div');
          note.style.cssText = 'padding:40px 10px;text-align:center;color:var(--text-secondary);font-size:12.5px;';
          note.textContent = 'Charts require an internet connection to load Chart.js from the CDN. The KPIs and table above still work offline.';
          c.parentElement.appendChild(note);
        });
      }
      return;
    }
    this.safeRender('renderTrendChart');
  }

  safeRender(fnName){
    try { this[fnName](); }
    catch(e){ console.error(fnName, e); }
  }

  renderKPIs(){
    const { dA, dB, drrA, drrB, daysA, daysB } = this.state;
    const a = this.sumRows(dA), b = this.sumRows(dB);
    const ra = this.sumRows(drrA), rb = this.sumRows(drrB);

    this.setKpi('kpi-collection', fmtCurrency(b.sales), a.sales, b.sales);
    this.setKpi('kpi-packages', fmtInt(b.orders), a.orders, b.orders, true);
    this.setKpi('kpi-users', fmtInt(b.users), a.users, b.users, true);

    const drrBVal = rb.sales / daysB, drrAVal = ra.sales / daysA;
    document.getElementById('kpi-drr').textContent = fmtCurrency(drrBVal);
    this.setChangeEl('kpi-drr-change', drrAVal, drrBVal, `vs ${fmtCurrency(drrAVal)}/day prior`);
  }

  setKpi(prefix, displayVal, aVal, bVal, isInt){
    document.getElementById(prefix).textContent = displayVal;
    this.setChangeEl(prefix+'-change', aVal, bVal, `vs ${isInt ? fmtInt(aVal) : fmtCurrency(aVal)} prior`);
  }

  setChangeEl(id, aVal, bVal, suffix){
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!aVal){ el.textContent = suffix; el.className='kpi-change'; return; }
    const pct = (bVal - aVal) / aVal;
    const arrow = pct >= 0 ? '▲' : '▼';
    el.innerHTML = `<span class="arrow">${arrow}</span>${fmtPct(pct)} <span style="color:var(--text-secondary);font-weight:400;">${suffix}</span>`;
    el.className = 'kpi-change ' + (pct >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative');
  }

  trendForecast(catFilter){
    const passes = (r) => this.rowPassesFilters(r) && (!catFilter || catFilter(r[1]));
    const maxD = toDate(this.raw.meta.max_date);
    const y = maxD.getUTCFullYear(), m = maxD.getUTCMonth();
    const curStart = monthStart(y, m);
    const d = maxD.getUTCDate();
    const lastDay = lastDayOfMonth(y, m);

    let py = y, pm = m - 1;
    if (pm < 0){ pm = 11; py -= 1; }
    const prevStart = monthStart(py, pm);
    const prevLastDay = lastDayOfMonth(py, pm);
    const prevEnd = monthEnd(py, pm);

    const curStartISO = isoDate(curStart), maxISO = isoDate(maxD);
    const prevStartISO = isoDate(prevStart), prevEndISO = isoDate(prevEnd);

    const rowsAll = this.raw.daily;
    const curRows = [], prevRows = [];
    for (let i=0;i<rowsAll.length;i++){
      const r = rowsAll[i];
      const dISO = r[0];
      if (dISO >= curStartISO && dISO <= maxISO){ if (passes(r)) curRows.push(r); }
      else if (dISO >= prevStartISO && dISO <= prevEndISO){ if (passes(r)) prevRows.push(r); }
    }

    const byDay = (rows) => {
      const map = new Map();
      for (const r of rows){
        const dayNum = toDate(r[0]).getUTCDate();
        if (!map.has(dayNum)) map.set(dayNum, {sales:0, orders:0});
        const o = map.get(dayNum);
        o.sales += r[6]; o.orders += r[7];
      }
      return map;
    };
    const curByDay = byDay(curRows);
    const prevByDay = byDay(prevRows);
    const mtd = this.sumRows(curRows);

    // Trend factor: this month's day-matched total vs prior month's same day-matched total
    const dayMatchLen = Math.min(d, prevLastDay);
    let mtdMatchSales=0, mtdMatchOrders=0, prevMatchSales=0, prevMatchOrders=0;
    for (let day=1; day<=dayMatchLen; day++){
      const c = curByDay.get(day) || {sales:0,orders:0};
      const p = prevByDay.get(day) || {sales:0,orders:0};
      mtdMatchSales += c.sales; mtdMatchOrders += c.orders;
      prevMatchSales += p.sales; prevMatchOrders += p.orders;
    }
    let trendSales = prevMatchSales > 0 ? mtdMatchSales/prevMatchSales : 1;
    let trendOrders = prevMatchOrders > 0 ? mtdMatchOrders/prevMatchOrders : 1;
    trendSales = Math.min(Math.max(trendSales, 0.3), 3);
    trendOrders = Math.min(Math.max(trendOrders, 0.3), 3);

    // Day-of-week seasonality from the trailing 90 days of actuals — used when prior month has no data for a given day
    const lookbackStart = addDays(maxD, -89);
    const lookbackStartISO = isoDate(lookbackStart);
    const lookbackRows = [];
    for (let i=0;i<rowsAll.length;i++){
      const r = rowsAll[i];
      if (r[0] >= lookbackStartISO && r[0] <= maxISO && passes(r)) lookbackRows.push(r);
    }
    const dowSales = [0,0,0,0,0,0,0], dowOrders = [0,0,0,0,0,0,0], dowCount = [0,0,0,0,0,0,0];
    for (const r of lookbackRows){
      const dow = toDate(r[0]).getUTCDay();
      dowSales[dow] += r[6]; dowOrders[dow] += r[7];
    }
    for (let i=0;i<90;i++){ dowCount[addDays(lookbackStart,i).getUTCDay()]++; }
    const avgDowSales = dowSales.map((v,i)=> dowCount[i] ? v/dowCount[i] : 0);
    const avgDowOrders = dowOrders.map((v,i)=> dowCount[i] ? v/dowCount[i] : 0);

    let remSales = 0, remOrders = 0;
    for (let day = d+1; day <= lastDay; day++){
      const refDay = Math.min(day, prevLastDay);
      const prev = prevByDay.get(refDay);
      let baseSales, baseOrders;
      if (prev && (prev.sales>0 || prev.orders>0)){
        baseSales = prev.sales; baseOrders = prev.orders;
      } else {
        const dow = addDays(curStart, day-1).getUTCDay();
        baseSales = avgDowSales[dow]; baseOrders = avgDowOrders[dow];
      }
      remSales += baseSales * trendSales;
      remOrders += baseOrders * trendOrders;
    }

    const prevMonthTotal = this.sumRows(prevRows);

    return {
      ym: ymOf(maxD), monthLabel: monthLabel(ymOf(maxD)),
      daysElapsed: d, daysRemaining: lastDay - d, lastDay,
      mtdSales: mtd.sales, mtdOrders: mtd.orders,
      forecastSales: mtd.sales + remSales, forecastOrders: mtd.orders + remOrders,
      prevMonthSales: prevMonthTotal.sales, prevMonthOrders: prevMonthTotal.orders,
      trendSales, trendOrders,
    };
  }

  computeForecast(){
    return this.trendForecast(null);
  }

  renderForecastPanel(){
    const fc = this.forecast;
    const card = document.getElementById('forecast-panel');
    document.getElementById('forecast-month-label').textContent = fc.monthLabel;

    document.getElementById('fc-collection').textContent = fmtCurrency(fc.forecastSales);
    this.setChangeEl('fc-collection-change', fc.prevMonthSales, fc.forecastSales, `vs ${fmtCurrency(fc.prevMonthSales)} last month`);

    document.getElementById('fc-packages').textContent = fmtInt(fc.forecastOrders);
    this.setChangeEl('fc-packages-change', fc.prevMonthOrders, fc.forecastOrders, `vs ${fmtInt(fc.prevMonthOrders)} last month`);

    card.title = `Projected Month-End ${fc.monthLabel}: MTD actual (${fmtCurrency(fc.mtdSales)}, day ${fc.daysElapsed}/${fc.lastDay}) + ${fc.daysRemaining} remaining day(s) projected from the matching day last month, scaled by this month's day-matched trend vs last month (falls back to the trailing 90-day day-of-week average where last month has no data). Recalculates with every filter above — not a guarantee. The Category-wise Month-End Forecast table below uses this same methodology per category, so its Total row matches this card exactly.`;
  }

    setCalendarMetric(metric){
    this.calendarMetric = metric;
    document.querySelectorAll('#calendar-section .preset-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
    const btn = document.getElementById('cal-metric-' + metric);
    if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
    this.renderCalendarGrid();
  }

  renderCalendarGrid(){
    const maxD = toDate(this.raw.meta.max_date);
    const todayDay = maxD.getUTCDate();

    // Last 6 reporting months, oldest first, ending at maxD's month
    const monthsList = [];
    const baseY = maxD.getUTCFullYear(), baseM = maxD.getUTCMonth();
    for (let i=5;i>=0;i--){
      let yy=baseY, mm=baseM-i;
      while (mm<0){ mm+=12; yy-=1; }
      monthsList.push({y:yy, m:mm});
    }

    const cells = monthsList.map(()=>({}));
    for (let i=0;i<this.raw.daily.length;i++){
      const r = this.raw.daily[i];
      if (!this.rowPassesFilters(r)) continue;
      const d = toDate(r[0]);
      const yy=d.getUTCFullYear(), mm=d.getUTCMonth(), day=d.getUTCDate();
      const idx = monthsList.findIndex(mo=>mo.y===yy && mo.m===mm);
      if (idx<0) continue;
      if (!cells[idx][day]) cells[idx][day] = {sales:0, users:0};
      cells[idx][day].sales += r[6];
      cells[idx][day].users += r[8];
    }

    let maxVal = 0.0001;
    for (let i=0;i<6;i++){
      const lastDay = lastDayOfMonth(monthsList[i].y, monthsList[i].m);
      const cap = (i===5) ? Math.min(lastDay, todayDay) : lastDay;
      for (let day=1; day<=cap; day++){
        const c = cells[i][day];
        if (!c) continue;
        const v = this.calendarMetric==='collection' ? c.sales/1e5 : c.users;
        if (v>maxVal) maxVal=v;
      }
    }

    let html = '<table class="calendar-table"><thead><tr><th>Month</th>';
    for (let day=1; day<=31; day++) html += `<th>${day}</th>`;
    html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for (let i=0;i<6;i++){
      const {y:yy, m:mm} = monthsList[i];
      const lastDay = lastDayOfMonth(yy, mm);
      const label = monthLabel(`${yy}-${String(mm+1).padStart(2,'0')}`);
      html += `<tr><td>${label}</td>`;
      for (let day=1; day<=31; day++){
        const dayExists = day <= lastDay && !(i===5 && day > todayDay);
        if (!dayExists){
          html += '<td class="cal-empty">&mdash;</td>';
          continue;
        }
        const c = cells[i][day];
        const v = c ? (this.calendarMetric==='collection' ? c.sales/1e5 : c.users) : 0;
        const intensity = Math.min(1, v/maxVal);
        const bg = this.calendarMetric==='collection'
          ? `rgba(61,108,179,${(0.08+intensity*0.55).toFixed(3)})`
          : `rgba(79,157,105,${(0.08+intensity*0.55).toFixed(3)})`;
        const display = this.calendarMetric==='collection' ? v.toFixed(2) : fmtInt(v);
        html += `<td style="background:${bg}">${display}</td>`;
      }
      html += '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';
    document.getElementById('calendar-container').innerHTML = html;

    document.getElementById('calendar-note').textContent = this.calendarMetric==='collection'
      ? 'Showing daily Collection in ₹ Lacs (gross sales ÷ 1,00,000), respecting the filters above. Empty (—) cells: date does not exist in that month, or not yet reported.'
      : 'Showing daily Unique Users (distinct_users) on packages bought, respecting the filters above. Empty (—) cells: date does not exist in that month, or not yet reported.';
  }


  categoryForecast(){
    const CATEGORY_ROLLUP = {
      'Cars':'Cars', 'Bikes':'Bikes', 'Real Estate':'Real Estate', 'Jobs':'Jobs',
      'VERIFIED_BADGE':'Verified',
      'Electronics & Appliances':'Goods', 'Furniture':'Goods', 'Mobiles':'Goods', 'Other Goods':'Goods',
    };
    const ORDER = ['Cars','Bikes','Real Estate','Jobs','Verified','Goods'];

    const maxD = toDate(this.raw.meta.max_date);
    const y = maxD.getUTCFullYear(), m = maxD.getUTCMonth();
    const curStart = monthStart(y, m);
    const d = maxD.getUTCDate();
    const lastDay = lastDayOfMonth(y, m);
    const daysRemaining = lastDay - d;

    let py = y, pm = m - 1;
    if (pm < 0){ pm = 11; py -= 1; }
    const prevStart = monthStart(py, pm), prevEnd = monthEnd(py, pm);
    const last7Start = addDays(maxD, -6);

    const maxISO = isoDate(maxD);
    const last7StartISO = isoDate(last7Start);
    const prevStartISO = isoDate(prevStart), prevEndISO = isoDate(prevEnd);

    // Last 7-Day DRR and Last Month Actual are plain sums, shown for run-rate context.
    // Projected Month-End uses the same day-matched trend methodology as the Month-End Forecast panel above (via trendForecast), not these sums.
    const actuals = {};
    ORDER.forEach(k => actuals[k] = { last7:0, prevMonth:0, pkgLast7:0, pkgPrevMonth:0 });
    const rows = this.raw.daily;
    for (let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
      const r = rows[i];
      if (!this.rowPassesFilters(r)) continue;
      const bucket = CATEGORY_ROLLUP[this.raw.cats[r[1]]];
      if (!bucket) continue;
      const dISO = r[0], sales = r[6], orders = r[7];
      const a = actuals[bucket];
      if (dISO >= last7StartISO && dISO <= maxISO){ a.last7 += sales; a.pkgLast7 += orders; }
      if (dISO >= prevStartISO && dISO <= prevEndISO){ a.prevMonth += sales; a.pkgPrevMonth += orders; }
    }

    const catIdxBucket = this.raw.cats.map(name => CATEGORY_ROLLUP[name] || null);

    const out = ORDER.map(k => {
      const fc = this.trendForecast(catIdx => catIdxBucket[catIdx] === k);
      const a = actuals[k];
      const drr7 = a.last7 / 7;
      const pkgDrr7 = a.pkgLast7 / 7;
      const mom = a.prevMonth > 0 ? (fc.forecastSales - a.prevMonth) / a.prevMonth : (fc.forecastSales > 0 ? 1 : null);
      const pkgMom = a.pkgPrevMonth > 0 ? (fc.forecastOrders - a.pkgPrevMonth) / a.pkgPrevMonth : (fc.forecastOrders > 0 ? 1 : null);
      return {
        label:k, mtd: fc.mtdSales, drr7, projected: fc.forecastSales, prevMonth: a.prevMonth, mom,
        pkgMtd: fc.mtdOrders, pkgDrr7, pkgProjected: fc.forecastOrders, pkgPrevMonth: a.pkgPrevMonth, pkgMom,
      };
    });

    // Total row: reuse the same overall forecast object driving the Month-End Forecast panel above
    // (already computed this cycle in applyFilters as this.forecast), so the two always match exactly.
    const overall = this.forecast;
    const totalLast7 = ORDER.reduce((s,k)=>s+actuals[k].last7, 0);
    const totalPkgLast7 = ORDER.reduce((s,k)=>s+actuals[k].pkgLast7, 0);
    const totalPrevMonth = ORDER.reduce((s,k)=>s+actuals[k].prevMonth, 0);
    const totalPkgPrevMonth = ORDER.reduce((s,k)=>s+actuals[k].pkgPrevMonth, 0);
    const total = {
      label: 'Total',
      mtd: overall.mtdSales, drr7: totalLast7/7, projected: overall.forecastSales, prevMonth: totalPrevMonth,
      mom: totalPrevMonth > 0 ? (overall.forecastSales - totalPrevMonth) / totalPrevMonth : null,
      pkgMtd: overall.mtdOrders, pkgDrr7: totalPkgLast7/7, pkgProjected: overall.forecastOrders, pkgPrevMonth: totalPkgPrevMonth,
      pkgMom: totalPkgPrevMonth > 0 ? (overall.forecastOrders - totalPkgPrevMonth) / totalPkgPrevMonth : null,
    };

    return { rows: out, total, maxD, d, lastDay, daysRemaining, curStart, prevStart, prevEnd, last7Start };
  }

  renderCategoryForecastTable(){
    const fc = this.categoryForecast();
    const lac = v => (v/1e5).toLocaleString('en-IN', {minimumFractionDigits:2, maximumFractionDigits:2});
    const pkgNum = v => fmtInt(v);
    const pkgRate = v => (v===null||v===undefined||!isFinite(v)) ? '—' : v.toFixed(1);
    const momCell = v => {
      if (v === null || v === undefined || !isFinite(v)) return '<td>&mdash;</td>';
      const cls = v >= 0 ? 'pos' : 'neg';
      const sign = v >= 0 ? '+' : '';
      return `<td class="${cls}">${sign}${(v*100).toFixed(1)}%</td>`;
    };
    const dataRow = (r, extraClass) => `<tr class="${extraClass||''}">` +
      `<td>${r.label}</td><td>${lac(r.mtd)}</td><td>${lac(r.drr7)}</td><td class="proj-cell">${lac(r.projected)}</td><td>${lac(r.prevMonth)}</td>${momCell(r.mom)}` +
      `<td>${pkgNum(r.pkgMtd)}</td><td>${pkgRate(r.pkgDrr7)}</td><td class="proj-cell">${pkgNum(r.pkgProjected)}</td><td>${pkgNum(r.pkgPrevMonth)}</td>${momCell(r.pkgMom)}` +
      `</tr>`;

    const subHead = () =>
      '<th title="Month-to-date actual">MTD</th>' +
      '<th title="Last 7-Day DRR (run-rate, informational)">DRR (7D)</th>' +
      '<th title="Projected Month-End (day-matched trend vs last month)">Projected</th>' +
      '<th title="Last month full-month actual">LM Actual</th>' +
      '<th title="MoM Growth: Projected vs Last Month Actual">MoM %</th>';

    let html = '<table class="cat-forecast-table">' +
      '<colgroup><col class="cf-col-cat">' + '<col class="cf-col-data">'.repeat(10) + '</colgroup>' +
      '<thead>' +
      '<tr>' +
        '<th rowspan="2" class="cf-cat">Category</th>' +
        '<th colspan="5" class="cf-group" title="Collection, &#8377; Lacs">Collection (&#8377;L)</th>' +
        '<th colspan="5" class="cf-group" title="Packages Sold (distinct orders)">Packages Sold</th>' +
      '</tr>' +
      '<tr>' + subHead() + subHead() +
      '</tr>' +
      '</thead><tbody>';
    fc.rows.forEach(r => { html += dataRow(r); });
    html += dataRow(fc.total, 'total-row');
    html += '</tbody></table>';
    document.getElementById('category-forecast-container').innerHTML = html;

    const prevLabel = monthLabel(`${fc.prevStart.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(fc.prevStart.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`);
    document.getElementById('category-forecast-note').textContent =
      `MTD window: ${isoDate(fc.curStart)} to ${isoDate(fc.maxD)} (day ${fc.d} of ${fc.lastDay}, ${fc.daysRemaining} day(s) remaining). Projected Month-End uses the same day-matched trend methodology as the Month-End Forecast panel above (this month's day-matched total vs last month's, with a trailing 90-day day-of-week fallback) \u2014 the Total row matches that panel exactly. Last 7-Day DRR (trailing 7 days through ${isoDate(fc.maxD)}) and Last Month (LM) Actual (full ${prevLabel}) are shown for run-rate context and do not drive the projection. Collection figures in \u20b9 Lacs (gross sales \u00f7 1,00,000); Packages Sold = distinct orders. Hover a column header for its full definition.`;
  }

  renderTrendChart(){
    const CATEGORY_ROLLUP = {
      'Cars':'Cars', 'Bikes':'Bikes', 'Real Estate':'Real Estate', 'Jobs':'Jobs',
      'VERIFIED_BADGE':'Verified',
      'Electronics & Appliances':'Goods', 'Furniture':'Goods', 'Mobiles':'Goods', 'Other Goods':'Goods',
    };
    const CAT_ORDER = ['Cars','Bikes','Real Estate','Jobs','Verified','Goods'];
    const CAT_COLORS = {
      'Cars':'#3D6CB3', 'Bikes':'#E08A3C', 'Real Estate':'#4F9D69',
      'Jobs':'#C4514E', 'Verified':'#8E6FBE', 'Goods':'#3EA6A6',
    };
    const catIdxBucket = this.raw.cats.map(name => CATEGORY_ROLLUP[name] || null);

    const rows = this.raw.daily;
    const collMap = new Map();
    const pkgByCat = new Map();
    for (let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
      const r = rows[i];
      if (!this.rowPassesFilters(r)) continue;
      const ym = r[0].slice(0,7);
      if (!this.msFY.has(fyOf(ym))) continue;
      collMap.set(ym, (collMap.get(ym)||0) + r[6]);
      const bucket = catIdxBucket[r[1]];
      if (bucket){
        if (!pkgByCat.has(ym)) pkgByCat.set(ym, {});
        const o = pkgByCat.get(ym);
        o[bucket] = (o[bucket]||0) + r[7];
      }
    }

    const showForecast = document.getElementById('f-forecast').checked;
    const fc = this.forecast;
    if (showForecast && fc && this.msFY.has(fyOf(fc.ym)) && !collMap.has(fc.ym)) collMap.set(fc.ym, 0);

    const months = [...collMap.keys()].sort();
    const collData = months.map(m => collMap.get(m));

    const pkgDatasets = CAT_ORDER.map(cat => ({
      type:'bar', label: cat,
      data: months.map(m => (pkgByCat.get(m)||{})[cat] || 0),
      backgroundColor: CAT_COLORS[cat], borderColor: CAT_COLORS[cat], borderWidth:0,
      stack: 'pkg-actual', yAxisID:'y1', order:3,
    }));

    const datasets = [
      ...pkgDatasets,
      { type:'line', label:'Collection', data: collData, borderColor:'#C4514E', backgroundColor:'#C4514E22', borderWidth:2.5, tension:.3, pointRadius:2, pointHoverRadius:5, yAxisID:'y', order:1 },
    ];

    if (showForecast && fc){
      const catForecast = this.categoryForecast();
      const projByCat = {};
      catForecast.rows.forEach(r => { projByCat[r.label] = r.projected; });
      const idx = months.indexOf(fc.ym);
      const projDatasets = CAT_ORDER.map(cat => ({
        type:'bar', label: cat + ' (Proj.)',
        data: months.map((m,i2)=> i2===idx ? (projByCat[cat]||0) : null),
        backgroundColor: CAT_COLORS[cat] + '4D', borderColor: CAT_COLORS[cat], borderWidth:1.5, borderDash:[4,3],
        stack: 'coll-forecast', yAxisID:'y', order:0,
      }));
      datasets.push(...projDatasets);
    }

    const ctx = document.getElementById('chart-trend').getContext('2d');
    if (this.charts.trend) this.charts.trend.destroy();
    this.charts.trend = new Chart(ctx, {
      data: { labels: months, datasets },
      options: {
        responsive:true, maintainAspectRatio:false,
        interaction:{ mode:'index', intersect:false },
        plugins:{
          legend:{ position:'top', labels:{usePointStyle:true, padding:10, font:{size:9.5}, boxWidth:9} },
          tooltip:{ callbacks:{ label: (c)=> c.dataset.yAxisID==='y' ? `${c.dataset.label}: ${fmtCurrency(c.parsed.y)}` : `${c.dataset.label}: ${fmtInt(c.parsed.y)}` } }
        },
        scales:{
          x:{ stacked:true, grid:{display:false}, ticks:{ maxRotation:60, minRotation:60, font:{size:10} } },
          y:{ stacked:true, position:'left', beginAtZero:true, ticks:{ callback:v=>fmtCurrency(v), font:{size:10} }, title:{display:true, text:'Collection', font:{size:11}} },
          y1:{ stacked:true, position:'right', beginAtZero:true, grid:{display:false}, ticks:{ callback:v=>fmtNum(v), font:{size:10} }, title:{display:true, text:'Packages by Category', font:{size:11}} },
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // Builds the per-package-type growth rows once; a Total View / DRR View toggle
  // (see setGrowthView) decides which pair of columns feeds the single panel.
  renderGrowthPanels(){
    const { dA, dB, drrA, drrB, daysA, daysB } = this.state;
    const mapA = this.byPackageType(dA), mapB = this.byPackageType(dB);
    const mapDA = this.byPackageType(drrA), mapDB = this.byPackageType(drrB);
    const keys = new Set([...mapA.keys(), ...mapB.keys(), ...mapDA.keys(), ...mapDB.keys()]);

    const items = [];
    for (const key of keys){
      const a = mapA.get(key), b = mapB.get(key);
      const da = mapDA.get(key), db = mapDB.get(key);
      const label = this.raw.subtypes[key.split('|')[1]];
      const grp = this.raw.groupings[key.split('|')[0]];
      const salesA = a ? a.sales : 0, salesB = b ? b.sales : 0;
      const drrAv = da ? da.sales/daysA : 0, drrBv = db ? db.sales/daysB : 0;
      if (salesA===0 && salesB===0 && drrAv===0 && drrBv===0) continue;
      items.push({
        grp, label,
        salesA, salesB, pct: salesA>0 ? (salesB-salesA)/salesA : (salesB>0?1:null),
        drrAv, drrBv, drrPct: drrAv>0 ? (drrBv-drrAv)/drrAv : (drrBv>0?1:null),
      });
    }

    this._growthItems = items;
    if (this.growthView === 'drr'){
      this.drawGrowthPanel('growth-panel-single', items, 'drrAv', 'drrBv', 'drrPct');
    } else {
      this.drawGrowthPanel('growth-panel-single', items, 'salesA', 'salesB', 'pct');
    }
  }

  setGrowthView(view){
    this.growthView = view;
    document.getElementById('gv-btn-total').classList.toggle('active', view === 'total');
    document.getElementById('gv-btn-drr').classList.toggle('active', view === 'drr');
    document.getElementById('growth-panel-note').textContent = view === 'drr'
      ? 'DRR View: daily run rate, prior \u2192 current period, grouped by Grouping, respecting all filters.'
      : 'Total View: prior \u2192 current period, grouped by Grouping, respecting all filters.';
    if (this._growthItems){
      if (view === 'drr') this.drawGrowthPanel('growth-panel-single', this._growthItems, 'drrAv', 'drrBv', 'drrPct');
      else this.drawGrowthPanel('growth-panel-single', this._growthItems, 'salesA', 'salesB', 'pct');
    }
  }

  // Renders a grouping-clustered breakdown: one section per Grouping with its overall growth,
  // and a bar per Package Type underneath showing that type's own growth/degrowth.
  drawGrowthPanel(containerId, items, aKey, bKey, pctKey){
    const GROUP_ORDER = ['Limits', 'Combo Limits', 'VAS', 'C2B', 'Other'];
    const container = document.getElementById(containerId);

    const groups = new Map();
    for (const it of items){
      if (it[aKey]===0 && it[bKey]===0) continue;
      if (!groups.has(it.grp)) groups.set(it.grp, []);
      groups.get(it.grp).push(it);
    }
    const grpNames = [...groups.keys()].sort((x,y)=> GROUP_ORDER.indexOf(x) - GROUP_ORDER.indexOf(y));

    if (!grpNames.length){
      container.innerHTML = '<div class="growth-empty">No data for the selected filters in this window.</div>';
      return;
    }

    let maxAbs = 0.0001;
    for (const it of items){ if (it[pctKey]!==null) maxAbs = Math.max(maxAbs, Math.abs(it[pctKey])); }

    let html = '';
    for (const grp of grpNames){
      const rows = groups.get(grp).slice().sort((x,y)=> (x[pctKey]??0) - (y[pctKey]??0));
      const sumA = rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+r[aKey],0), sumB = rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+r[bKey],0);
      const overallPct = sumA>0 ? (sumB-sumA)/sumA : (sumB>0?1:0);
      html += `<div class="growth-group">
        <div class="growth-group-header">
          <div class="ghl"><span class="grp-badge" style="background:${GROUP_COLORS[grp]||'#999'}">${grp}</span><span class="gh-count">${rows.length} type${rows.length===1?'':'s'}</span></div>
          <span class="growth-group-overall ${pctClass(overallPct)}">${fmtPct(overallPct)} overall</span>
        </div>`;
      for (const r of rows){
        const pct = r[pctKey];
        const cls = pct===null ? '' : (pct>=0?'pos':'neg');
        const halfWidth = pct===null ? 0 : Math.min(50, Math.abs(pct)/maxAbs*50);
        html += `<div class="growth-item">
          <span class="gi-label" title="${r.label}">${r.label}</span>
          <div class="growth-bar-track"><div class="growth-bar-mid"></div>${pct!==null ? `<div class="growth-bar-fill ${cls}" style="width:${halfWidth}%"></div>` : ''}</div>
          <span class="gi-val ${cls}">${pct===null ? '—' : fmtPct(pct)}</span>
        </div>`;
      }
      html += '</div>';
    }
    container.innerHTML = html;
  }

  renderTable(){
    const { dA, dB, drrA, drrB, daysA, daysB } = this.state;
    const mapA = this.byPackageType(dA), mapB = this.byPackageType(dB);
    const mapDA = this.byPackageType(drrA), mapDB = this.byPackageType(drrB);
    const keys = new Set([...mapA.keys(), ...mapB.keys(), ...mapDA.keys(), ...mapDB.keys()]);

    const rows = [];
    let totA={sales:0,orders:0,users:0}, totB={sales:0,orders:0,users:0}, totDA={sales:0,orders:0}, totDB={sales:0,orders:0};

    for (const key of keys){
      const [grpIdx, subIdx] = key.split('|').map(Number);
      const a = mapA.get(key) || {sales:0,orders:0,users:0};
      const b = mapB.get(key) || {sales:0,orders:0,users:0};
      const da = mapDA.get(key) || {sales:0,orders:0};
      const db = mapDB.get(key) || {sales:0,orders:0};
      if (a.sales===0 && b.sales===0 && da.sales===0 && db.sales===0) continue;

      totA.sales+=a.sales; totA.orders+=a.orders; totA.users+=a.users;
      totB.sales+=b.sales; totB.orders+=b.orders; totB.users+=b.users;
      totDA.sales+=da.sales; totDA.orders+=da.orders;
      totDB.sales+=db.sales; totDB.orders+=db.orders;

      rows.push({
        grp: this.raw.groupings[grpIdx], sub: this.raw.subtypes[subIdx],
        collA:a.sales, collB:b.sales, collGrowth: a.sales? (b.sales-a.sales)/a.sales : (b.sales>0?1:0),
        pkgA:a.orders, pkgB:b.orders,
        ausers:a.users, busers:b.users,
        userGrowth: a.users? (b.users-a.users)/a.users : (b.users>0?1:0),
        drrCollA: da.sales/daysA, drrCollB: db.sales/daysB,
        drrCollGrowth: da.sales? ((db.sales/daysB)-(da.sales/daysA))/(da.sales/daysA) : (db.sales>0?1:0),
        drrPkgA: da.orders/daysA, drrPkgB: db.orders/daysB,
        drrPkgGrowth: da.orders? ((db.orders/daysB)-(da.orders/daysA))/(da.orders/daysA) : (db.orders>0?1:0),
      });
    }

    const cols = [
      {key:'grp', label:'Grouping', fmt:'text'},
      {key:'sub', label:'Package Type', fmt:'text'},
      {key:'collA', label:'Collection (Prior)', fmt:'currency'},
      {key:'collB', label:'Collection (Current)', fmt:'currency'},
      {key:'collGrowth', label:'Collection Growth', fmt:'pct'},
      {key:'pkgA', label:'Packages (Prior)', fmt:'int'},
      {key:'pkgB', label:'Packages (Current)', fmt:'int'},
      {key:'userGrowth', label:'User Growth', fmt:'pct'},
      {key:'drrCollA', label:'DRR Coll. (Prior)', fmt:'currency'},
      {key:'drrCollB', label:'DRR Coll. (Current)', fmt:'currency'},
      {key:'drrCollGrowth', label:'DRR Coll. Growth', fmt:'pct'},
      {key:'drrPkgA', label:'DRR Pkg (Prior)', fmt:'num1'},
      {key:'drrPkgB', label:'DRR Pkg (Current)', fmt:'num1'},
      {key:'drrPkgGrowth', label:'DRR Pkg Growth', fmt:'pct'},
    ];

    const totalRow = {
      grp:'TOTAL', sub:'', collA:totA.sales, collB:totB.sales,
      collGrowth: totA.sales? (totB.sales-totA.sales)/totA.sales:0,
      pkgA:totA.orders, pkgB:totB.orders,
      userGrowth: totA.users? (totB.users-totA.users)/totA.users:0,
      drrCollA: totDA.sales/daysA, drrCollB: totDB.sales/daysB,
      drrCollGrowth: totDA.sales? ((totDB.sales/daysB)-(totDA.sales/daysA))/(totDA.sales/daysA):0,
      drrPkgA: totDA.orders/daysA, drrPkgB: totDB.orders/daysB,
      drrPkgGrowth: totDA.orders? ((totDB.orders/daysB)-(totDA.orders/daysA))/(totDA.orders/daysA):0,
    };

    // Subtotals by Grouping, shown at the end of the table
    const grpMap = new Map();
    for (const r of rows){
      if (!grpMap.has(r.grp)) grpMap.set(r.grp, { grp:r.grp, sub:'Subtotal', collA:0, collB:0, pkgA:0, pkgB:0, ausers:0, busers:0, drrCollA:0, drrCollB:0, drrPkgA:0, drrPkgB:0 });
      const g = grpMap.get(r.grp);
      g.collA+=r.collA; g.collB+=r.collB; g.pkgA+=r.pkgA; g.pkgB+=r.pkgB;
      g.ausers+=r.ausers; g.busers+=r.busers;
      g.drrCollA+=r.drrCollA; g.drrCollB+=r.drrCollB; g.drrPkgA+=r.drrPkgA; g.drrPkgB+=r.drrPkgB;
    }
    const subtotalRows = [...grpMap.values()].map(g => ({
      ...g,
      collGrowth: g.collA? (g.collB-g.collA)/g.collA : (g.collB>0?1:0),
      userGrowth: g.ausers? (g.busers-g.ausers)/g.ausers : (g.busers>0?1:0),
      drrCollGrowth: g.drrCollA? (g.drrCollB-g.drrCollA)/g.drrCollA : (g.drrCollB>0?1:0),
      drrPkgGrowth: g.drrPkgA? (g.drrPkgB-g.drrPkgA)/g.drrPkgA : (g.drrPkgB>0?1:0),
    })).sort((a,b)=>b.collB-a.collB);

    this.tableRows = rows;
    this.tableTotal = totalRow;
    this.tableSubtotals = subtotalRows;
    this.tableCols = cols;
    this.drawTable();
  }

  drawTable(){
    const { col, dir } = this.sortState;
    const rows = [...this.tableRows].sort((a,b)=>{
      const av=a[col], bv=b[col];
      const cmp = (typeof av === 'string') ? av.localeCompare(bv) : (av-bv);
      return dir==='asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
    });

    const fmtCell = (v, fmt) => {
      switch(fmt){
        case 'text': return v;
        case 'currency': return fmtCurrency(v);
        case 'int': return fmtInt(v);
        case 'num1': return (v||0).toFixed(1);
        case 'pct': return `<span class="${pctClass(v)}">${fmtPct(v)}</span>`;
        default: return v;
      }
    };

    let html = '<table class="data-table"><thead><tr>';
    for (const c of this.tableCols){
      const arrow = this.sortState.col===c.key ? (this.sortState.dir==='asc'?' ▲':' ▼') : '';
      html += `<th onclick="dashboard.sortTable('${c.key}')">${c.label}${arrow}</th>`;
    }
    html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    const rowHtml = (r, cls) => {
      const isTotalLike = (cls||'').split(' ').includes('total-row');
      let h = `<tr class="${cls||''}">`;
      for (const c of this.tableCols){
        if (c.key==='grp' && !isTotalLike){
          h += `<td><span class="grp-badge" style="background:${GROUP_COLORS[r.grp]||'#999'}">${r.grp}</span></td>`;
        } else {
          h += `<td>${fmtCell(r[c.key], c.fmt)}</td>`;
        }
      }
      return h + '</tr>';
    };

    html += rowHtml(this.tableTotal, 'total-row');
    for (const r of rows) html += rowHtml(r, '');
    if (this.tableSubtotals && this.tableSubtotals.length){
      html += `<tr class="subtotal-spacer"><td colspan="${this.tableCols.length}"></td></tr>`;
      for (const r of this.tableSubtotals) html += rowHtml(r, 'subtotal-row');
      html += rowHtml({ ...this.tableTotal, grp: 'OVERALL TOTAL' }, 'total-row overall-total-row');
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';

    document.getElementById('table-container').innerHTML = html;
  }

  sortTable(col){
    if (this.sortState.col === col){
      this.sortState.dir = this.sortState.dir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
    } else {
      this.sortState = { col, dir: 'desc' };
    }
    this.drawTable();
  }
}

const dashboard = new Dashboard(RAW);
</script>
</body>
</html>
